sql.where:
AND ( 
  wp_posts.ID NOT IN (
				SELECT object_id
				FROM wp_term_relationships
				WHERE term_taxonomy_id IN ({tt other})
			)
)

AND ( 
  (
				SELECT COUNT(1)
				FROM wp_term_relationships
				WHERE term_taxonomy_id IN ({tt child},{tt other})
				AND object_id = wp_posts.ID
			) = 2
)

AND ( 
  EXISTS (
					SELECT 1
					FROM wp_term_relationships
					INNER JOIN wp_term_taxonomy
					ON wp_term_taxonomy.term_taxonomy_id = wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id
					WHERE wp_term_taxonomy.taxonomy = 'zz_cf'
					AND wp_term_relationships.object_id = wp_posts.ID
				)
)

AND ( 
  NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT 1
					FROM wp_term_relationships
					INNER JOIN wp_term_taxonomy
					ON wp_term_taxonomy.term_taxonomy_id = wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id
					WHERE wp_term_taxonomy.taxonomy = 'zz_cf'
					AND wp_term_relationships.object_id = wp_posts.ID
				)
)

sql.where:
AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN ({tt other})

)

sql.join: LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships AS tt1 ON (wp_posts.ID = tt1.object_id)
sql.where:
AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN ({tt flat}) 
  AND 
  ( 
    tt1.term_taxonomy_id IN ({tt other}) 
    OR 
    wp_posts.ID NOT IN (
				SELECT object_id
				FROM wp_term_relationships
				WHERE term_taxonomy_id IN ({tt child})
			)
  )
)
